sinopsis.es: Una persona joven encuentra a su gato muerto en la bañera. Decide cuidarlo a pesar de unas advertencias de su madre cuyo sentido todavía no comprende. A través de la muerte de su gato, toma conciencia del paso del tiempo.
sinopsis.en: A young adult discovers their cat, dead in the bathtub. They decide to take care of him despite their mom’s warnings that they don’t understand yet. Through their cat’s death, the protagonist becomes aware of the passing time.
